intro: Kumkura Gold Gel blends ayurvedic botanicals in a cooling gel base to revive dull, tired skin and deliver balanced hydration. With consistent use, it helps even out tone, refine texture, and minimize the look of pores while leaving skin fresh and comfortable. The non‑greasy formula layers well with sunscreen by day and facial oils at night; results vary by skin type and routine.
